posts.title: Brown Friday: Why the Day After Thanksgiving Is a Plumber's Busiest Day
posts.description: ABILENE, Texas (KTAB/KRBC) – While millions of Americans spend Thanksgiving enjoying holiday meals before heading out for Black Friday shopping, plumbers prepare for a different kind of rush.
